_doc: Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; FIRST MATCH WINS. Each rule needs `from_match` (substring of from_email) and an action. Optional fields: `subject_match` (substring of subject), `min_age_days` / `max_age_days` (inclusive), `label` (only with action=label), `confidence`, `reasoning`. Match is case-insensitive. After the rules list, classify.py falls through to its heuristic defaults.
_whitelist_doc: Domains that must NEVER be auto-deleted by the blunt subject-keyword spam tripwire (financial, services you use, nonprofits you support, schools). Sender RULES can still archive/label these; this only blocks keyword-based deletion.
